::: {.column-page}

We are a research group in the Department of Biological Sciences at the University of Pittsburgh.

Our research program operates at the intersection of environmental data science and global change biology. We aim to provide both theoretical insights and practical solutions to the challenges posed by our rapidly changing world.

Research directions:

- Changing phenology
- Changing biodiversity
- Ecological forecasting
- Allergen phenology

:::
